failing_condition.name: account_lost
failing_condition.explanation: Compares the served account set with the candidate account set. An account the served publication holds, the candidate does not, and that is not exempted as a TERMINATED closure, raises account_lost. The exemption reads only TERMINATED directory entries, and this account is marked ACTIVE.

same_as_cottonwood.statement: Not the same condition. Cottonwood IB-pr-571 (record at box/dell2 1eda0665e4, not on this base) is refused by the validator custody check at holdings_snapshot.py line 403 after the COT screen drops two no-position source rows. This account has no row on 2026-10-13 and is refused by the publish gate condition account_lost at line 3058.

fix_options.option: Source correction: re-land the account's custody row in the 2026-10-13 dim_balance partition if the account is live at the custodian
fix_options.effect: Measured: the account has one row on the 2026-10-12 partition and none on 2026-10-13. A correct row restores its ACCOUNT node and clears account_lost, with no change to the screen, the validator or the guard.

fix_options.effect: The gate lists the account under closed_accounts_not_refused instead of refusing with account_lost. The candidate does not regain the account, and the directory marks it ACTIVE today, so custodian confirmation comes first.

notes: Source rows: the account has one row on the 2026-10-12 dim_balance partition (the served date) and zero rows on the 2026-10-13 candidate partition. Read by get-object to scratch only; the row values are not recorded here.
